mock-large.description: Frontier-tier pricing. Use when a case needs cost to add up quickly.

mock-medium.description: Mid-tier pricing. The default choice for an ordinary agent step.

mock-small.description: Small-tier pricing. 20,000 output tokens cost exactly 0.10 USD; 4,000 input tokens cost exactly 0.004 USD.

mock-local.description: A genuinely free model (a local or self-hosted runner). Every token costs 0.00 USD; SPEC §9.7 treats this as a passing, measured zero.
